sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "business_organizations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cheque_instruments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "party_type" TEXT NULL, "party_id" INTEGER NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "cheque_number" TEXT NULL, "bank_name" TEXT NULL, "branch_name" TEXT NULL, "account_number" TEXT NULL, "drawer_name" TEXT NULL, "issue_date" TEXT NULL, "due_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "deposited_at" TEXT NULL, "cleared_at" TEXT NULL, "bounced_at" TEXT NULL, "cancelled_at" TEXT NULL, "bounce_reason" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "settlement_payment_id" INTEGER NULL, "clearance_journal_entry_id" INTEGER NULL, "dishonour_journal_entry_id" INTEGER NULL, "resolution_type" TEXT NULL, "resolution_journal_entry_id" INTEGER NULL, "resolved_at" TEXT NULL, "resolution_note" TEXT NULL, "replacement_cheque_id" INTEGER NULL, "legacy_direct_bank" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("legacy_direct_bank" IN (0, 1)), "created_by" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "updated_by" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), CHECK (direction IN ('incoming','outgoing')), CHECK (amount_cents > 0), CHECK (status IN ('received','issued','deposited','cleared','bounced','cancelled','replaced')), CHECK (party_type IS NULL OR party_type IN ('customer','supplier')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "party_account_payments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "cheque_instrument_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES cheque_instruments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "party_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "party_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "applied_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "currency_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "settlement_transaction_id" INTEGER NULL, "recognized_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "reversed_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), UNIQUE ("cheque_instrument_id"), CHECK (party_type IN ('customer','supplier')), CHECK (direction IN ('incoming','outgoing')), CHECK (amount_cents > 0), CHECK (applied_cents >= 0 AND applied_cents <= amount_cents), CHECK (status IN ('open','partially_applied','applied','reversed')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "party_account_payment_applications" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "account_payment_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES party_account_payments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "document_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "document_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sale_payment_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES sale_payments (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "purchase_payment_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES purchase_payments (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "applied_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "reversed_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), CHECK (document_type IN ('sale','purchase')), CHECK (amount_cents > 0), CHECK (status IN ('active','reversed')), CHECK ((document_type = 'sale' AND purchase_payment_id IS NULL) OR (document_type = 'purchase' AND sale_payment_id IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cheque_confirmations" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "source_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "confirmed_at" TEXT NULL, "confirmed_by" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "bounce_reason" TEXT NULL, "cleared_payment_id" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), UNIQUE ("source_table", "source_id"));
